description:
Test build, not a release. For stable builds use main/bundles/stable.json.

Images and GIFs in text posts: image button in the Text tab's formatting bar (and in the edit dialog of text posts). Any number per post. Each image becomes an i.redd.it link in the body: inline in rif, a plain link on old Reddit and in other apps.
Test: new text post with a few images and formatting; edit it to add and remove an image.
